{{Quote|We are an Empire ruled by the ''majority''! An Empire ruled by a new Constitution! An Empire of ''laws'', not of politicians! An Empire devoted to the preservation of a just society. Of a ''safe'' and ''secure'' society! We are an Empire that will stand for ''ten thousand years''!|Palpatine|<ref name="Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith (novelization)" />}}
The '''Galactic Empire''', also known as the '''First Galactic Empire''', '''Palpatine's New Order''', the '''Imperium''' or simply the '''Empire''' and later the '''Old Empire''', was [[The galaxy/Legends|the galactic]] government established by [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] to replace the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] and bring [[Order of the Sith Lords|Sith]] rule to the galaxy.

The Republic, which had lasted for at least 25,034 years, ended following a period of intense [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|political turmoil]] and the subsequent devastation of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. After the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|death]] of [[Dooku/Legends|Count Dooku]] above [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the [[Battle of Utapau/Legends|death]] of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] on [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]] and finally the [[Mission to Mustafar/Legends|massacre]] of the [[Separatist Council/Legends|leaders]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] on [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]], Chancellor Palpatine (by then ruling with near-absolute power) [[Order 66/Legends|began]] a [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|purge]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], and then [[Declaration of a New Order|proclaimed]] himself [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] of the galaxy and reorganized the Galactic Republic into "the first Galactic Empire" on the galactic capital, Coruscant.

The Galactic Empire collapsed in the aftermath of [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] Palpatine's [[Death/Legends|death]] during the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], leading to the formation of both the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]], resulting in the effective partition of the former Empire. 

==History==
===Origin===
{{Quote|We stand on the threshold of a new beginning. In order to ensure our security and continuing stability, the Republic will be reorganized into the first ''Galactic Empire'', for a safe and secure society, which I assure you will last for ten thousand years. An Empire that will continue to be ruled by this august body and a sovereign ruler chosen for life.|[[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] Palpatine, in his [[Declaration of a New Order]]|<ref name="Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith (novelization)" />}}
[[File:Epic_Battles.jpg|left|thumb|200px|The growing corruption within the Galactic Senate of the Republic eventually led to the outbreak of the Clone Wars, which caused devastation across the galaxy.]]
The Galactic Empire can be said to have begun with the scheming aspiration of the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], known to the public as [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] Palpatine of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. He was inspired by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Resurrected Sith Empire]], which dominated the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] over three millennia earlier.<ref name="BoS">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref> In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], he began manipulating pivotal events, such as instigating the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Naboo crisis]], in which he used the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], led by [[Viceroy of the Trade Federation/Legends|Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]] as a pawn, to lead [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Amidala]] into calling for a "[[Vote of No Confidence/Legends|Vote of No Confidence]]" in [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]], effectively replacing him and eventually winning the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]] with assistance from the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]]. When his first [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]], [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]], was defeated by [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], Sidious took on the former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] as his new apprentice. In [[24 BBY/Legends|24 BBY]], Dooku then helped found the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] with the formation of the [[Separatist Council/Legends|Separatist Council]], led again by Nute Gunray, on [[Raxus Prime/Legends|Raxus Prime]], [[Raxus Address/Legends|igniting]] the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] Cold War known as the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]]. Palpatine, at the end of his second term, was allowed to [[Emergency Powers Act/Legends|stay in power]] until the crisis was resolved. This eventually led to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], which started with the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle]] of [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], which ended the Separatist Crisis.

[[File:70RepublicYouthSpeechFinal.jpg|right|thumb|Through institutions such as COMPOR, support for Supreme Chancellor Palpatine during the Clone Wars increased profusely, with the majority of the Republic supporting Palpatine's increased power and authority.]]
At the beginning of the Clone Wars, Palpatine was an efficient and effective leader who quickly brought to an end the corruption in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]]; his authority was greatly increased even more so than at the start of the Separatist Crisis, via [[Junior Representative/Legends|Acting Senator]] [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]], while the Senate willingly furnished as they gave more and more emergency powers to him. Eventually, the Senate lost most of its power and became little more than a formality that Palpatine had to go through to pass his laws. Yet the Senate retained some symbolic power; Chancellor Palpatine still hid behind the pomp and circumstance of appealing to the Senate, but his power existed in his control over thousands of Senators that he had brought into his own web of corruption.

[[File:84PalpatineSpeechFinal.jpg|left|thumb|With the end of the Clone Wars, Palpatine used his authority to reorganize the Republic into the First Galactic Empire, declaring himself as its Emperor.]]
However, after the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|death]] of Count Dooku onboard the [[Invisible Hand/Legends|''Invisible Hand'']] above [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and the [[Battle of Utapau/Legends|death]] of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] on [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] discovered that Palpatine was a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] Lord, and after informing [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] of his discovery, a Jedi task force led by Windu himself [[Showdown on Coruscant|attempted to arrest him]]. After a brief duel, Palpatine appeared to be defeated. Skywalker arrived and demanded the Sith Lord's life be spared, that he might stand trial. Deeply troubled, Skywalker nonetheless helped Palpatine kill Windu, prompting him to be held under Palpatine's sway as his new apprentice and enforcer, Darth Vader. Palpatine then [[Order 66/Legends|proceeded]] to carry out the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]], including the [[Operation: Knightfall/Legends|massacre]] of the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] itself, which eliminated almost all the Jedi, while simultaneously [[Mission to Mustafar/Legends|wiping out]] the leaders of the Confederacy on [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]], including the Separatist Council representative Nute Gunray, who was Anakin's last victim. The Separatists were reduced to a [[Separatist holdouts/Legends|shadow]] of their former selves, thus bringing an end to the Clone Wars. Secure in his power and position, Palpatine used the so-called ''Jedi rebellion'' to issue the [[Declaration of a New Order]] and declared himself [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] of the galaxy in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], replacing the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] with the Galactic Empire. Likewise, Palpatine vowed that the newly formed Empire would reign with ten thousand years of peace. This was done literally at the same time, when Anakin had ended the Clone Wars, with the assassinations of the Confederacy's leaders.

[[File:Galacticsenate.png|right|thumb|200px|The majority of the Galactic Senate supported Palpatine's New Order, ushering in the Imperial Era with thunderous applause.]]
Many people under the new Empire enthusiastically supported the vision outlined in the Declaration of a New Order, largely due to the violence that had plagued the galaxy for so long. Many Senators wholeheartedly supported the new government while a number of more cautious senators chose to watch and wait to see how the new government would handle the affairs of state. It promised to trade frailty for strength, chaos for order, and uncertainty for decisiveness. In retrospect, the foundation of the Empire had already been set down during Palpatine's chancellorship and all potential threats eliminated; therefore, the transition from Republic to Empire was relatively smooth.

[[File:Sithdelscener1pic2.jpg|left|thumb|200px|Only a handful of Senators saw through Palpatine's deception and made secret efforts to undermine his authority in private.]]
It is important to note that not all of the Senators liked what they saw. Shortly before the start of the Clone Wars in 22 BBY, the [[Loyalist Committee/Legends|Loyalist Committee]] was formed by more democratic senators. By the eve of the empire, near the end of the Clone Wars in 19 BBY, the Loyalist Committee was reorganised into the [[Petition of 2000]], who sought to bring the worries of these Senators to Palpatine. This petition was led by [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]], [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]], and Padmé Amidala. Palpatine's dismissal of their concerns was one factor that led Organa and Mothma to help found the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].

===Imperialization===
{{Main|Imperialization/Legends}}
{{Quote|I have brought peace, freedom, justice, and security to my new Empire!|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]|<ref name="RotS" />}}
[[File:BeyghorSahdett-Rep79.jpg|right|thumb|200px|The Jedi Order would be branded traitors to the new Empire and hunted down by clone stormtroopers, though some Jedi would survive the initial purge.]]
With the rise of the Empire, all the institutions of the old Republic found themselves either dismantled or modified beyond recognition. There was a riot of renaming all things "Imperial" to glorify the new Emperor: overnight, the [[Coruscant sector/Legends|Coruscant sector]] was renamed the Imperial Sector, [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] itself was renamed Imperial Center, and [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]] was renamed Imperial City. The Galactic Senate became the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]], the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] became the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] with the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], which made up the majority of the GAR, reorganized into the [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|Stormtrooper Corps]], and the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] became the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]]. The four decrepit intelligence agencies of the Republic were merged into [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]], with former [[Senate Bureau of Intelligence/Legends|Senate Bureau of Intelligence]] (SBI) director [[Armand Isard/Legends|Armand Isard]] at its head. The [[Imperial Palace/Legends|Palace of the Republic]] was rebuilt and expanded, becoming the Imperial Palace, eclipsing all other buildings on Imperial Center. The former [[Commission for the Protection of the Republic/Legends|Commission for the Protection of the Republic]] (COMPOR) was renamed the [[Commission for the Preservation of the New Order/Legends|Commission for the Preservation of the New Order]] (COMPNOR). Within days, there were few names left to remind the people that there had ever been a Galactic Republic.

[[File:Jace_Dallin_choke.jpg|left|thumb|200px|The Empire moved quickly to purge any traitorous personal from their ranks, with any opposition to the Emperor or his decree of the Jedi's extermination met with merciless force.]]
Palpatine consolidated his power by launching [[Emperor's purge|Purges]] against his opponents, most notably the Old Republic officers, whom he had not been able to seduce to his side. Any officers who held anti-Imperial sentiments were arrested and executed by Admiral [[Mulleen]], under Palpatine's orders. Palpatine's first purge of the Imperial Navy occurred within just two weeks into the Empire's rule.

In addition, many former Separatist worlds had their assets confiscated by [[Finance Minister]] [[Gahg]] under Palpatine's orders.<ref name="Dark Times 1">[[Dark Times 1|''Dark Times'' 1]]</ref>

[[File:Hurst_Romodi.jpg|right|thumb|200px|The Empire would fiercely crack down on any resistance movements which dared oppose them, with the new Imperial Army swiftly moving to crush the Separatist holdouts which sprung up after the Clone Wars.]]
During the first few years of the Empire, the galaxy saw the single largest military buildup in history. A permanent class of [[Moff/Legends|Moffs]] and regional governors was established to more efficiently govern individual sectors and regions of the Empire. Popular support for the policies of Palpatine's administration was high. In addition, the Empire also pursued a [[Reconquest of the Rim|reconquest]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Middle]] and [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rims]] of the Galaxy, which included getting rid of any and all remaining Separatist influence.<ref name="TEGW" /> During the time of the [[Battle of Kelrodo-Ai]] during the [[Western Reaches Operation]] in [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]], the Empire restored order and rule of law in eight sectors, and liberated 95 worlds.<ref name="SWI132">{{InsiderCite|132|The Guns of Kelrodo-Ai (short story)}}</ref> For many this was a period of celebration: the Separatists had at last been defeated and order and the rule of law had been returned to sectors that had long been given over to [[Pirate/Legends|piracy]] and crime. Citizens who had become disillusioned with their [[Senator/Legends|senators]] found a new voice through organizations like COMPNOR, and the Outer Rim was reconciled to Imperial rule through [[Outer Rim reconciliation efforts|conciliatory gestures]] like the pardoning and early release of certain Separatist prisoners.<ref name="TEGW" />

Nonetheless, many members of the Imperial Military were unhappy about Palpatine's plans for imperialization: One Imperial officer, in particular, the headmaster of the [[Imperial Academy/Legends|Imperial Academy]] [[Gentis]], who lost all but [[Caul Gentis|one]] of his sons to Palpatine's warmongering ways during the imperialization effort, formed a [[Ghost Prison incident|military coup]] against Palpatine and poisoned him with [[Aorth-6]] as a means to bring peace to the Empire, something he realized that Palpatine would never pursue. The coup, while initially successful, ultimately failed.<ref name="GP">''[[Star Wars: Darth Vader and the Ghost Prison]]''</ref>

===The Dark Times===
{{Quote|We must move quickly. The Jedi are relentless. If they are not all destroyed, it will be civil war without end.|Palpatine|<ref name="RotS" />}}
[[File:Bothan_UM.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Emperor Palpatine would employ Bothan infiltrators to devastate the Caamasi, destroying yet another potential threat to the Empire.]]
As this process unfolded, the Emperor saw the respected [[Caamasi/Legends|Caamasi]] as a threat to his New Order, so he ordered the devastation of their home planet [[Caamas/Legends|Caamas]]. A group of [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] infiltrators were responsible for sabotaging Caamas's shield generators, leaving the planet vulnerable to Imperial orbital bombardment. The once beautiful world was devastated during this attack, turned into a poisoned wasteland. The peaceful Caamasi were dispersed throughout the galaxy. In [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]], the Emperor constructed the huge, asteroid-shaped superweapon ''[[Eye of Palpatine]]'' in order to use it to destroy a Jedi enclave on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. However, the deadly superweapon was sabotaged by two Jedi Knights and the Jedi on Belsavis managed to escape.

[[File:Wilhuff_Tarkin-DSOTM.png|thumb|right|150px|Captain Wilhuff Tarkin perpetrated the Ghorman Massacre by landing his flagship on Ghorman protestors.]]
Around the same time, a group of beings were protesting the tyranny of the Galactic Empire on the planet [[Ghorman/Legends|Ghorman]] in the [[Sern sector/Legends|Sern sector]]. [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin's]] flagship was blocked by peaceful protesters who stood on the ship's landing pad and refused to move. With implied permission from Palpatine, Tarkin landed the ship anyway, right on the protesters, injuring and killing many. This came to be known as the [[Ghorman Massacre/Legends|Ghorman Massacre]]. The Alliance to Restore the Republic was founded in its wake.

[[File:VaderBadasseryOnKashyyyk-ERC.jpg|thumb|left|150px|An uprising of Wookiees on Kashyyyk led by surviving Jedi was brutally crushed by Darth Vader and the 501st Legion]]
Many Jedi also rebelled against Palpatine's regime. [[Olee Starstone]] and a group of [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] Jedi survivors along with [[Roan Shryne]] attempted to re-establish the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] but were unsuccessful. The group fled to [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] to find out if any Jedi survived there, but the Empire launched a massive takeover of the planet. Darth Vader killed Roan Shryne and some of the Jedi, with Starstone barely escaping with her life. A [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] among them, named [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], fled the city to find his family. Meanwhile, [[Ferus Olin]] along with his friends including Jedi Master [[Fy-Tor-Ana|Solace]] caused much havoc on Imperial-controlled planets including a rebellion on the planet of [[Bellassa/Legends|Bellassa]], the two Jedi break-ins of the destroyed [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on Coruscant, and the destruction of an Imperial Garrison and Weapon Munitions Center on Naboo. Also on [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]], a group of Jedi including Master [[Tsui Choi/Legends|Tsui Choi]] and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Bultar Swan/Legends|Bultar Swan]] planned to draw Darth Vader into a trap and kill him. Due to exceptionally bad planning and tactics, every one of them was killed, though Vader's suit was slightly damaged.

In [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], the Emperor and Vader were the targets of an [[Anti-Sith conspiracy|attempted coup]] by a group of treacherous Imperial officers led by [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Trachta]]. Trachta saw the Sith as foolish and archaic, and believed that the Empire should not be ruled by a two-man cult. They planned to use a batch of altered [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] loyal only to them to destroy the two Sith Lords. However, their plot failed in part because of internal fighting between the co-conspirators.

===Resistance to Imperial rule===
{{Main|Galactic Civil War/Legends}}
{{Quote|Listen, I can't get involved. I've got work to do. It's not that I like the Empire; I hate it! But there's nothing I can do about it right now. It's such a long way from here.|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] to [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|<ref name="Episode 4" />}}
[[File:Starkiller_dead.jpg|thumb|right|200px|The death of Galen Marek at the hands of the Emperor would transform the former Sith apprentice into a martyr, inspiring his allies to form the Rebel Alliance against the Empire.]]
In [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]], after the true nature of the Empire became clear, three of the most influential senators, [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], [[Garm Bel Iblis/Legends|Garm Bel Iblis]] of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], and [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] of [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]], along with others, were on the brink of starting a great rebellion against the Empire. To lure the dissidents out of hiding, the Emperor and Darth Vader had [[Galen Marek]], Vader's secret Sith apprentice, rally the Rebels. Brought together by him, they met in secret on Corellia and signed the [[Corellian Treaty]]. This officially formed the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], more commonly referred to as the Rebel Alliance. They were arrested on the spot, and taken to be executed by Palpatine himself on board the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] but Marek turned to the light side of the Force and [[Battle on Death Star I|freed them]], sacrificing his own life. On [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], the Alliance commemorated Marek's death and used his [[Alliance Starbird|family crest]] as the new organization's symbol. Just weeks later, a [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|full scale war]] broke out between the Imperials and the Rebels, which was an armed military conflict that would consume the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] for many years to come.

[[File:Destruction_of_Despayre-TEA.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Tarkin would order the newly constructed Death Star to destroy the planet Despayre, over which the superweapon had been constructed.]]
However, the threat of rebellion allowed Palpatine to endorse the [[Tarkin Doctrine/Legends|Tarkin Doctrine]] of rule by fear of force rather than force itself. If anything, Palpatine welcomed the formation of the fledgling Rebel Alliance as a legitimate excuse to remove the last vestiges of the Republic and tighten his grip on the galaxy. To test the Death Star's power, Tarkin ordered the [[Destruction of Despayre|Destruction]] of [[Despayre]], the planet which the space station was built over which took three waves and likely consumed its only moon [[Haroon]] in the process.

In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]] was [[Dissolution of the Imperial Senate/Legends|dissolved]] and taking what was left of the Old Republic with it, which only strengthened the Rebellion. Almost immediately afterwards, Tarkin ordered the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|Destruction]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], which took a single fire and was [[The Graveyard|completely obliterated]], despite their captive [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia's]] protest, who was eventually [[Rescue of Princess Leia/Legends|rescued]] by the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|Millennium Falcon]] crew.

[[File:Exds.png|thumb|right|200px|The destruction of the first Death Star in the Battle of Yavin would mark a major turning point in the growing civil war against the Empire.]]
A key instrument in the enforcement of the doctrine was intended to be the Death Star, a moon-sized space station with sufficient firepower to easily destroy a planet with a single discharge of its powerful [[Superlaser/Legends|superlaser]]. Whereas many planets could afford planetary deflector shields capable of warding off virtually any conventional attack, none could defend against the power of that weapon. The weapon was destroyed in the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle]] of [[Yavin Prime/Legends|Yavin]], which marked the first major space-based victory for the Rebel Alliance. At this point, Palpatine and the rest of the Empire realized that the Rebellion was a major threat to them and one that should be taken seriously, for the destruction of the Death Star was a massive blow to the Empire.

[[File:Ds2destroyed.png|thumb|left|200px|The Battle of Endor, which was intended by the Empire to be the final destruction of the rebellion, would backfire, resulting in the deaths of Palpatine and Darth Vader, alongside the new Death Star II.]]
After the superweapon's destruction, the Rebels had finally found their footing. They began consistent strikes on Imperial-held territories, inciting continuing resentment against the Empire and taking them under the Rebels' banner. This included the Anti-Imperial propaganda for destroying Alderaan, which set thousands of worlds in the galaxy to protest against the empire's brutality, even in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. The Alliance had also cultivated renowned leaders and heroes as distinctive as [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] and the Jedi-to-be [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]. Although the Empire gained the upper hand in most campaigns against the Alliance (such as the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle]] of [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] and the construction of the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]]), they could not prevent the unstoppable juggernaut that the Rebels unleashed upon them and felt their grip in the galaxy slowly weakening. Thus, in the climax of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] that was the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle]] of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]], where Anakin Skywalker would also aide the Rebels in fulfilling an [[Chosen One/Legends|ancient Jedi prophecy]], with both Palpatine's death and his own at the battle's end, the Empire was finally unseated from its control over the galaxy.

===Fracturing and warlord era===
{{Main|Imperial Civil War}}
[[File:IsardMJBTEP.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Ysanne Isard was one of several Imperial leaders who desperately attempted to keep the Empire intact while dozens of Imperial warlords began to carve up their own territories.]]
The Empire, however, was too large, to be destroyed in one blow; for the next fifteen years, the Rebels (soon renamed as the provisional government; the [[Alliance of Free Planets]] and then the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]) fought to free the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] from former Imperials styling themselves as independent [[Warlord/Legends|warlords]] as well as Imperial loyalists, such as [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] and [[Ysanne Isard]]. The [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Sector/Legends|sectors]] that were still under imperial control after Palpatine's death were basically military juntas. The sectors that were too weak to be governed by the remnants of the empire were abandoned by their scattered military and became failed states overnight. Fortunately, in later years these forgotten parts of the galaxy were saved by the New Republic. 

Even prior to the fall of Emperor Palpatine in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the signs of fragmentation began to slowly reveal themselves as early as [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] with the rebel's propaganda of the then-recent Destruction of Alderaan. In just a matter of days after the Battle of Endor, the Empire was thrown into a [[Imperial Civil War|power struggle]] and would meanwhile resume [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|their conflict]] with the New Republic in a two-front war. The first incursion was that of Moff [[Kalast]], followed by the more serious situation involving the free-selling arms dealer [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Harkov]], and finally culminating in the major Imperial infighting with [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Demetrius Zaarin]]. The situation became serious when Zaarin attempted a ''coup d'état'' on Emperor Palpatine, managing to miraculously capture the Sith Lord by abducting him from his flagship, in a plot later thwarted by Admiral Thrawn.

[[File:Zsinj.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Warlord Zsinj would become one of the most powerful Imperial warlords, building up his own Empire which opposed the official Empire on Coruscant and competed with other Imperial Remnants.]]
Immediately following the Imperial defeat at the Battle of Endor, [[Grand Vizier/Legends|Grand Vizier]] [[Sate Pestage/Legends|Sate Pestage]] seized control of the Empire. However, he lacked the charisma, Force powers, and terrifying presence that both Emperor Palpatine and Darth Vader used to keep the Empire together. Admiral [[Blitzer Harrsk]] was the first Imperial to declare himself a warlord and set up his own mini-Empire, but he would not be the last. Others included Admiral [[Treuten Teradoc]], Admiral [[Zsinj]], and [[General/Legends|General]] [[Sander Delvardus]], to name a few.

Sate Pestage only managed to hold the throne for a scant six months before he was deposed by the Imperial Ruling Council composed of three Tribunes. The Ruling Council was acting on the manipulations of Imperial Intelligence Director Ysanne Isard though, and the Ruling Council's leadership of the Empire ended under brutal conditions executed by Isard.

[[File:Lusankya_escaping_Coruscant.jpg|thumb|right|200px|When the rebel's New Republic seized control of Coruscant, Isard would retreat off planet using the Lusankya, a super star destroyer hidden under Coruscant's surface, which killed millions.]]
In [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]] the New Republic would [[Liberation of Coruscant (Galactic Civil War)|liberate]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] from the local Imperial faction and thus making an official return to democracy. However, Ysanne Isard managed to hold the Empire together and stem off aggressive warlords, as well as [[Trioculus]] and the [[Rajah Ubooki|false Kadann]], who also claimed the throne, for nearly two years before losing control of Imperial Center. When Ysanne Isard started to lose her grasp over the Empire, she had her scientists develop a biological virus targeting only [[Alien/Legends|non-humans]] that she later let loose in Coruscant. So when Coruscant fell under the Rebel's attack, led by Rogue Squadron, they inherited Isard's disease that caused havoc for the starting government. With the loss of Coruscant, the Empire dissolved further and, soon, Warlord Zsinj was seen as the single largest Imperial threat in the galaxy. Isard managed to evade death and escaped to her own little kingdom.

The remnants of the Empire found themselves for the first time on the same side of the table as the New Republic. Both governments viewed Warlord Zsinj as their biggest threat. Zsinj came under the pressure of both governments, but it was not until Admiral [[Teren Rogriss]] teamed up with General Solo that they managed to bring Zsinj down.

The temporary alliance was over and new fighting erupted between the Empire and the New Republic over the scraps of Zsinj's domain. However, the New Republic dealt blow after blow to the Empire, winning most of the engagements and further humiliating the Empire by pushing them off of the monstrous ship producing world of [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]].

[[X1]] had been drawing out plans for a new Galactic Empire, with himself as Emperor. However, his attempts were ultimately thwarted by his own brother, [[X2]].

====Imperial resurgence====
:''Main articles: [[Thrawn campaign]], [[Pre–Shadow Hand campaign]]''
[[File:GAThrawn-SWI66.png|thumb|left|[[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]].]]
The remnants of the Galactic Empire by [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]] continued to lose ground until the return of Grand Admiral Thrawn, a military genius, the only nonhuman to climb the ranks of the Imperial Navy, and the last remaining Grand Admiral. Thrawn's campaign recaptured nearly half of the galaxy in the name of the fallen Empire; however, it came to a sudden end when Thrawn was assassinated by his own bodyguard. Captain Pellaeon, Thrawn's second-in-command, knew that he could not continue Thrawn's inspired campaign and ordered a retreat.

The New Republic immediately took advantage of the Imperial power vacuum and moved to cut off future Imperial threats in the form of the remaining warlords. Using the pretext of pursuing Imperials who had committed various crimes the New Republic began their push against [[Prince/Legends|Prince]]-Admiral [[Delak Krennel]]. Despite Krennel's new ally in a clone of Ysanne Isard and the real Isard's machinations to steal back her Super Star Destroyer the Republic emerged victorious and began pressing their advantage even more, leaving the Core worlds with minimal protection.

In [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]], the surviving members of the [[Imperial Ruling Council/Legends|Imperial Ruling Council]], under [[Ars Dangor/Legends|Ars Dangor's]] leadership, gathered several belligerent Imperial warlords to organize a military campaign into the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Galactic Core]]. The warlords were emboldened by the late Grand Admiral Thrawn's triumphs and accomplishments against the New Republic, which was still recovering from the devastating Thrawn campaign. The New Republic was powerless to repel the military might of the [[Dark Empire]], which swiftly conquered much of the economically, politically and strategically vital Core Worlds within weeks. [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]], [[Esseles/Legends|Esseles]], [[Ralltiir/Legends|Ralltiir]], as well as the [[Metellos system/Legends|Metellos]] and [[Kaikielius system/Legends|Kaikielius]] systems, were seized by the Empire, while [[Caprioril]] was [[Siege of Caprioril|besieged]] by the Imperial Navy and the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Borderland Regions]] were [[Attack on the Borderland Regions|devastated]]. The offensive culminated in the decisive [[Second Battle of Coruscant]], in which the New Republic abandoned the planet and the Empire retook the galactic capital. Having assumed total control over the Core Worlds, the Empire had been restored to its former glory, while the New Republic leadership relocated its headquarters to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].

[[File:Monument_Plaza_Mutiny.jpg|thumb|200px|The Imperial Civil War on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].]]
After Coruscant had been retaken, the Imperial Ruling Council invited important political and military leaders to the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]] to elect the next [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] and re-establish the disbanded Imperial Senate. However, the Moffs, Grand Moffs, Army, Navy, COMPNOR, Intelligence, [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Security Bureau]] and [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitorius]], as well as various [[Governor/Legends|governors]], noblemen and bureaucrats, craved absolute power over the Imperial state. The Empire plunged into anarchy and chaos: the Imperial Intelligence and Security Bureau orchestrated the assassinations of their political enemies, while COMPNOR purists attempted to take control of the regime in order to prevent any changes to the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]].

Soon, an armed conflict broke out amongst the various political and military factions, each trying to dominate the Empire. The disarrayed Imperial Military was responsible for committing atrocities, massacring civilians and destroying entire worlds. Above Coruscant, the orbit became littered with space debris and the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] conducted [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|orbital bombardments]], transforming the surface of the planet into a decaying urban wasteland. On the surface, stormtroopers, walkers and tanks fought on the streets of the planet-wide [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|ecumenopolis]]. Much of the galactic capital was laid to waste, and millions of native [[Coruscanti/Legends|Coruscanti]] perished during the Imperial infighting. The New Republic took advantage of the chaos, performing raids on Imperial territories through the use of captured Imperial vessels. The civil war ended only several months following the retaking of Coruscant.

====Return of Palpatine====
{{Main|Dark Empire|Operation Shadow Hand}}
[[File:Emperorreborn.jpg|thumb|left|Palpatine's return.]]
In [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]], when it seemed the Galactic Empire would never recover, that hopes were lost, and that the New Republic was finally close to victory, an enigmatic figure took the title of Emperor. However, this person was no new Emperor, for Palpatine had returned. Returning in fresh clone bodies imbued with the dead despot's spirit, he proceeded for six years to rebuild and finally regained the strength to again challenge the New Republic. While most of the rank and file troops returned to loyal service, few of the warlords did, while most fled for their lives. Palpatine regrouped the fragmented Empire's many warlords and loyal forces to fight along side his [[Dark Empire]], a revived [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] regime based on secret throne world of [[Byss/Legends|Byss]] in the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]]. Determined to crush the weakened New Republic and once again subjugate the galaxy under his dark rule, the Galactic Emperor initiated a military campaign known as [[Operation Shadow Hand]]. Eventually, Palpatine intended to transform the Galactic Empire into a magocracy in which he ruled the galaxy forever with his loyal [[Dark side adept/Legends|Dark Side Adepts]].

The Emperor turned Jedi Knight Luke Skywalker to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] to serve as the new [[Supreme Commander (Galactic Empire)/Legends|Supreme Commander of the Imperial Forces]], but Skywalker defected back to the New Republic and the astromech droid [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] programmed the Emperor's awe-inspiring superweapons, the [[World Devastator]]s, to destroy each other during the [[Battle of Calamari|First Battle of Mon Calamari]]. In the [[Battle of Pinnacle Base]], Palpatine summoned a [[Force storm (wormhole)|Force storm]] to obliterate a New Republic fleet orbiting [[Da Soocha V]]. However, Skywalker and his sister [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], causing the storm to annihilate Palpatine and his flagship, the [[Eclipse-class dreadnought|''Eclipse''-class dreadnought]] [[Eclipse (Eclipse-class)|''Eclipse'']].

While Palpatine was presumably dead, the Shadow Hand Strategy was taken over by the Emperor's most powerful [[darksider]], [[Executor (Imperial rank)|Military Executor]] [[Sedriss QL]]. Sedriss suffered heavy casualties in attempting to [[Battle of Balmorra|occupy]] the factory world of [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] and perished in the [[Skirmish on Ossus|Battle of Ossus]]. However, the Emperor returned once again to spearhead his galactic conquest and commissioned his newest superweapon, the [[Galaxy Gun]]. The superweapon destroyed Da Soocha V, the [[Nespis VIII|Space City]], [[Krinemonen]] and [[Hirsi]], forcing numerous [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] and [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] worlds into accepting Imperial rule. The Empire had succeeded in conquering most of the galaxy and becoming the leading galactic superpower, while the New Republic was on the brink of downfall.

However, a group of Imperial politicians and officers, led by [[Carnor Jax]] and [[Sarcev Quest]], sabotaged the Emperor's clone bodies in order to assassinate Palpatine and take control of the Imperial state. In the [[Battle of Onderon (Galactic Civil War)|skirmish]] on [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]], Emperor Palpatine's final clone body was killed and mortally wounded Jedi Knight [[Empatojayos Brand]] took the Galactic Emperor's spirit to the [[Netherworld of the Force/Legends|Netherworld of the Force]]. Following the Emperor's final demise, the [[Star Dreadnought/Legends|Star Dreadnought]] ''[[Eclipse II]]'' was programmed to collide with the Galaxy Gun, destroying both superweapons. The Galaxy Gun accidentally launched a [[particle disintegrator warhead]] on Byss, destroying the planet and killing its inhabitants.

In these cataclysmic events, the Empire lost the Galactic Emperor, two superweapons, the Imperial Fleet orbiting Byss, and most of Palpatine's loyal advisors, officers, soldiers and Dark Side Adepts. The last major action of a Sith-led Empire, Operation Shadow Hand resulted in the final destruction of Palpatine's Empire, as the [[Destruction of Byss]] effectively terminated all political and military structures that upheld the Imperial state. Without the leadership and guidance of the late Emperor Palpatine, the Galactic Empire had practically ceased to exist. In the midst of chaos, rival warlords fled to their pocket empires, disorganized Imperial forces abandoned the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]], and the New Republic retook Coruscant. As a result, the resurrected Empire fell to its knees and self-destructed.

===Death throes and collapse===
Following Palpatine's final death, Carnor Jax seized the Imperial throne. However, the Imperial fleet was left rudderless without orders from their Emperor. They retreated from the Core Worlds, and the Empire quickly crumbled. Many fleet commanders refused to follow Jax and his Interim Ruling Council, and they broke away to form various warlord holdings. Jax's [[Crimson Empire]] thus held a small territory, limited to a narrow band of space that stretched from the Outer Rim to the Colonies.<ref name="NEC" /> It was the only territory still answerable to centralized Imperial control.<ref name="TEA" />

Not long after the New Republic had reclaimed Coruscant from the [[Dark Empire]], after its fall, the [[New Jedi Order]] was created by Luke Skywalker in the [[Jedi Praxeum]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]], where he became the order's first [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]]. This had undone Palpatine's [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|extermination]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], that had [[Order 66/Legends|began]] with the [[Declaration of a New Order|formation of the empire]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].

When Jax was [[Duel in The Squall|killed]] by his fellow former Guardsman [[Kir Kanos]],<ref name="Crimson Empire 6">[[Crimson Empire 6|''Crimson Empire'' 6]]</ref> the [[Noble/Legends|aristocrat]] [[Burr Nolyds]] took control of the Ruling Council.<ref name="Handbook">[[Star Wars Handbook 2: Crimson Empire|''Star Wars Handbook'' 2: ''Crimson Empire'']] {{C|under "The Imperial Interim Ruling Council"}}</ref> He was soon killed by [[Nom Anor]], an ally of Councilor [[Xandel Carivus]] who was aiding Carivus's plans to become the new head of the council.<ref name="Handbook Nom">[[Star Wars Handbook 2: Crimson Empire|''Star Wars Handbook'' 2: ''Crimson Empire'']] {{C|under "Nom Anor"}}</ref> Anor was secretly an advance [[Executor (Yuuzhan Vong rank)|agent]] of the [[Extragalactic/Legends|extra-galactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Species/Legends|species]], and, unknown to even Carivus, he was targeting the council in order to hasten the Empire's collapse in advance of a massive [[Yuuzhan Vong War|Yuuzhan Vong invasion]] of the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]].<ref name="NEGTC">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]'' {{C|under "Nom Anor"}}</ref> Carivus was elected the new head of the council,<ref name="Crimson Empire II 1">[[Crimson Empire II: Council of Blood 1|''Crimson Empire II: Council of Blood'' 1]]</ref> but he soon disbanded the council and declared himself the new Emperor.<ref name="Crimson Empire II 5">[[Crimson Empire II: Council of Blood 5|''Crimson Empire II: Council of Blood'' 5]]</ref> When the New Republic [[Battle of Ord Cantrell|attacked]] his powerbase on [[Ord Cantrell/Legends|Ord Cantrell]] and he was killed by Kanos,<ref name="Crimson Empire II 6">[[Crimson Empire II: Council of Blood 6|''Crimson Empire II: Council of Blood'' 6]]</ref> utter collapse of Imperial authority followed, and the Empire ceased to exist.<ref name="TEA" />

===Legacy===
{{Quote|A lot of time has passed since the last of the Imperials were beaten back, and we've had a good look through the Imperial archives. Virtually all Imperial forces have been accounted for. You might be able to spin out a story where someone managed to scrape together a task force from ships mistakenly listed as destroyed. Some people say there are whole fleets out there that no one knows about. But even if that were true, where are the thousands of trained crew supposed to come from? Every time anything goes wrong anywhere in the Republic, some conspiracy buff or another trots out a theory of a cabal intent on reviving the Empire. If someone runs out of place mats in the palace commissary, it's an Imperial plot. I for one no longer believe in that particular bogeyman. The Empire is as dead as Darth Vader.|Han Solo, to [[Dracmus]]|<ref name="AaS">''[[Assault at Selonia]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Grand_Admiral_Pellaeon.jpg|thumb|[[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]], the "Old Man of the Empire."]]
In the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]], the [[Warlord/Legends|warlords]] divided into several pocket empires, waging aggressive warfare against their rivals and building heavily fortified planets known as the "[[Fortress world/Legends|fortress worlds]]". The warlords were known for spending entire fortunes to build war matériel and adopting pompous titles like "[[Omnipotent Battle Leader]]." The two most powerful factions in the fragmented Empire were the [[Zero Command]], led by "Supreme Warlord" Blitzer Harrsk, and the [[Greater Maldrood]], led by "[[High Admiral]]" Treutlen Teradoc. Harrsk controlled the largest territory, while Teradoc had the largest military. Harris's attempt to take control of the [[Atravis sector/Legends|Atravis sector]] in the Outer Rim Territories was opposed by Teradoc, and the mutual hatred between the Zero Command and the Greater Maldrood developed into full-scale warfare. Another notable Imperial warlord was "[[Superior General]]" Sander Delvardus who constructed the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]] [[Knight Hammer|''Night Hammer'']] as his personal command ship.

While the warlords struggled in the Deep Core, [[Ambassador/Legends|Ambassador]] [[Furgan]] of [[Carida/Legends|Carida]] caused Admiral [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Ackbar's]] temporal retirement and poisoned [[Chief of State (New Republic)/Legends|Chief of State]] [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] to cripple the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], which was recovering from Operation Shadow Hand. However, Carida and its prestigious [[Carida Academy/Legends|Caridan Military Academy]] were destroyed by the [[Sun Crusher]] superweapon, piloted by rogue Jedi [[Kyp Durron]], and Furgan himself perished during the [[Battle of Anoth (Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Anoth]], in which he attempted to kidnap [[Anakin Solo]] and brainwash the baby into a Force-sensitive Emperor. Meanwhile, the [[Maw fleet|fleet]] under Admiral [[Natasi Daala]]'s command was discovered in the [[Maw Cluster/Legends|Maw Cluster]]. Daala launched her [[Daala campaign|guerilla campaign]] to overthrow the New Republic, attacking Dantooine and Mon Calamari. She also attempted to crash an Imperial Star Destroyer on Coruscant, but the plan was foiled by Durron and the Sun Crusher. Eventually, the [[Maw Installation]], the [[Death Star prototype]] and the Sun Crusher were destroyed in the [[Battle of the Maw|Battle]] of the [[Maw Installation]], and Daala was believed to be dead.

Following the Battle of the Maw Installation, [[Natasi Daala|Daala]] fled to the Deep Core and made contact with Supreme Warlord Harrsk. She allied with Grand Admiral Thrawn's second-in-command Captain Pellaeon, who now served High Admiral Teradoc, and together they gathered Harrsk, Teradoc, Delvardus, [[Malfkla Yzu|Yuz]] and the nine other warlords to an Imperial communications relay station on [[Tsoss Beacon/Legends|Tsoss Beacon]]. Daala's scheme to end the Imperial Civil War failed as the warlords refused to collaborate and organize a joint military campaign against the New Republic. Daala and Pellaeon assassinated the thirteen most powerful warlords with nerve gas, bringing their military forces together under the banner of the Empire.

The [[Imperial Reunification]] in [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]], gave birth to the [[United Warlord Fleets]], ending the [[Imperial Civil War]] and unified the feuding imperial factions into the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]]. Under Daala's leadership, the fleets rebuilt the weakened Imperial Military by manufacturing countless walkers, starfighters and Star Destroyers, and even women and non-humans were allowed to work for the military. After Colonel [[Ivan Cronus]], former second-in-command to Superior General Delvardus, joined the fleets, Daala seized the ''Night Hammer'' and renamed it the ''Knight Hammer''. While Cronus committed lightning raids to [[Khomm/Legends|Khomm]], [[Porus Vida]] and the [[Chardaan Shipyards]], Daala and Pellaeon attacked Luke Skywalker's Jedi Praxeum on Yavin 4, knowing that the New Jedi Order was the most dangerous menace against the Empire. However, the [[Assault on Yavin 4|Battle of Yavin 4]] was a military disaster for the fleets, as Pellaeon's fleet was pushed by Jedi Knight [[Dorsk 81]] to the edge of the [[Yavin system/Legends|Yavin system]], Cronus perished with his command ship, and the ''Knight Hammer'' fell into [[Yavin Prime/Legends|Yavin Prime]]. After the battle, Daala turned command over to Vice Admiral Pellaeon. Pellaeon, now Supreme Commander of the Imperial Navy, relocated the Imperial Remnant to the Outer Rim and annexed the [[Pentastar Alignment]]. The fortress world of [[Bastion/Legends|Bastion]], formerly known as Sartinaynian, became the capital of the new Imperial Remnant, and the [[Council of Moffs/Legends|Council of Moffs]] was established to succeed the [[Diet of Imperial Planetary Governors]].

Several more defeats occurred over the ensuing years, forcing the Imperial Remnant into eight backwater [[Sector/Legends|sectors]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Seeing that defeat was imminent, [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Pellaeon]] finally admitted the need to sue for peace. In [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]], after a [[Pellaeon–Gavrisom Treaty|peace accord]] was signed on board the [[Chimaera/Legends|Chimaera]]'' ''with the New Republic's [[Chief of State (New Republic)/Legends|representative]] [[Ponc Gavrisom]], the Remnant than settled into a period of stability and had finally ended the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. This ended the Galactic Empire's regime over the galaxy, after thirty-eight years of [[Humanocentrism|Humanocentric]] dictatorship, as opposed to Palpatine's promising ten thousand year rule.
[[File:JaggedFel-ERC.jpg|thumb|293x293px|Jagged Fel, the first Fel Emperor.]]
In the years following the Galactic Civil War, the Imperial Remnant would ally itself with the New Republic's successor the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] in the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Yuuzhan Vong War|War]] and the [[Killik/Legends|Swarm]] [[Swarm War|War]], but were a grey area in the [[Second Galactic Civil War]], between the Imperial Remnant, [[Confederation]] and the Galactic Alliance.

The Imperial Remnant's shift toward democracy did not last indefinitely. In [[44 ABY]], in the aftermath of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith emergence|Lost Tribe War]], the Remnant ceased to exist after its reorganization into a [[Fel Empire]], ruled by a [[Fel dynasty|hereditary monarchy]], possibly by merging with the Confederation. [[Jagged Fel]], the former Head of State who had attempted to reform the Remnant into a republican style of government in the first place, was crowned as the first Emperor since Palpatine. In just over a month, the Cold War between the Galactic Alliance and the newly revived Galactic Empire had begun, which would last for several decades. Shortly after the outbreak of the Cold War, Jagged Fel created the [[Imperial Knight]]s on [[Bastion/Legends|Bastion]], for the newly formed Fel Empire, who were the successors of the [[Emperor's Royal Guard/Legends|Imperial Royal Guards]], but unlike the Imperial Royal Guards, who were a form of diehard loyalists to Emperor Palpatine and included the occasional [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]], the Imperial Knights were a form of [[Gray Jedi]] who abandoned the Sith's philosophy.

And that was just how the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] was for about eighty years, two superpowers divided over territory and control. It wasn't until [[126 ABY]], that things started to change, [[122 ABY|four years]] into the [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] [[Ossus Project|Project]], with the Yuuzhan Vong and the Galactic Alliance, attempted to [[Terraforming/Legends|restore]] the worlds devastated by the Yuuzhan Vong War, the [[One Sith]], who had been hiding for nearly a century sabotaged the project and framed the species for it. The [[New Jedi Order|Jedi]] knew that they weren't responsible but were unable to prove it, while thousands of systems showed their support for the Fel Empire. In [[127 ABY]], the situation worsened, when the truce between the two superpowers was broken, the One Sith came out of hiding, sided with the Fel Empire and together they [[Sith–Imperial War|declared war]] with the Galactic Alliance, where the Fel Empire's influence had increased significantly. In [[130 ABY]], the war had ended with an imperial victory and reduced the Galactic Alliance to the [[Galactic Alliance Remnant]]. However, when Fel's "allies" within One Sith, led by [[Darth Krayt]], operated a [[Attack on Emperor Fel|coup]] to betray the Imperials and forced the emperor into exile, the Fel Empire was ruined and replaced with [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]], which was ruled by the leader of the One Sith with an iron fist. With Coruscant secured, Darth Krayt usurped the Imperial throne and declared himself emperor of the New Galactic Empire, who [[Massacre at Ossus|began]] the [[Third Jedi Purge]]. This new Empire, however, would later fall to ruin as well after Krayt's death under the hands of [[Cade Skywalker]].
[[File:MarasiahFel.jpg|thumb|312x312px|[[Marasiah Fel]], the new leader of the Fel Empire.]]
Krayt's rule [[Battle of Coruscant (Second Imperial Civil War)|collapsed]] due to the [[Second Imperial Civil War]], alongside his opponent, the [[Empire-in-exile|Fel Empire in exile]], after the death of the exiled Emperor [[Roan Fel]] in [[138 ABY]]. Even though the Fel dynasty was restored later, it was later merged into the [[Galactic Federation Triumvirate]], alongside the Galactic Alliance Remnant and the fragmented New Jedi Order and thus was no longer the sole administration of the known universe anymore. Fel's daughter, Princess [[Marasiah Fel]], became the new ruler of the empire. While Emperor Palpatine had promised the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|senate]] 10,000 years of Imperial rule over the galaxy, it could be argued to have ultimately lasted for a grand total of only 157 years. All that remained of the First Galactic Empire was the order and benevolence running through the Fel Empire's veins.

The Sith who created the Empire in the first place were [[Darth Wredd's insurgency|defeated]] in [[139 ABY]]. Not long after the One Sith's [[Battle of the Floating World|last stand]], Marasiah Fel turned the Imperial Knights to the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|Light Side of the Force]] and presumably rounded up the remaining Sith members, including their new leader [[Darth Nihl]], which ultimately resulted in the (wrongly) presumed permanent extinction of the Sith religion itself. The last known galactic conflict, however, did not end until the secular supporters of the One Sith were defeated themselves in [[140 ABY]].<ref name="Legacy—War 6">[[Legacy — War 6|''Legacy — War'' 6]]</ref><ref name="Legacy 2013 18">[[Legacy (2013) 18|''Legacy'' (2013) 18]]</ref> After the end of all these conflicts, the galaxy had entered an era of unity and peace for the first time since before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], and was, after 172 years of Emperor Palpatine's influence, finally free of the old Emperor's evil.

==Government and politics==
===Overview===
{{Quote|Yeah, he says the Empire is the worst thing that ever happened to the galaxy. Dismantling every vestige of democracy, seizing assets, killing whole populations. He thinks I'm joining the bad guys.|[[Biggs Darklighter/Legends|Biggs Darklighter]] to Luke Skywalker, speaking of [[Huff Darklighter]]|<ref name="E8">[[Empire 8|''Empire'' 8]]</ref>}}
[[File:ImperialFigureheads.png|thumb|left|200px|[[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] Palpatine, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] and the common [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]], three faces of the Galactic Empire]]
The Empire was ruled with absolute power by Emperor Palpatine, with Sate Pestage as Grand Vizier, and Darth Vader as [[Supreme Commander (Galactic Empire)/Legends|Supreme Commander]] of all Imperial Forces. Imperial rule was authoritarian. There was little to no freedom of speech and dissidents were punished harshly. According to the introduction to the [[Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide|official field manual]] for the Empire's military forces, this was because the Empire aimed and celebrated one ruler, code of law, common tongue, and education in social progress, and wanted to ensure unity.<ref name="Imperial Handbook">''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''</ref>

Systems were grouped as sectors while sectors, in turn, were sorted into [[Oversector/Legends|oversectors]]. Respectively, these region types were governed by Moffs and Grand Moffs,<ref name="TEA" /> who exercised power in the name of the Emperor.<ref name="Episode 4" />

===Rulers of the Empire===
After being named Galactic Emperor in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], Palpatine turned the sclerotic remains of the Galactic Republic into an empire and thus introduced authoritarian rule over the entire galaxy. Whereas before leaders had served for fixed terms until being succeeded by duly elected successors, now the thorny issue of Imperial succession complicated matters.

For his part, Palpatine showed little real interest in the matter of who would succeed him. In fact, he apparently intended from the start to live and reign forever, even developing his own [[Rule of One (Palpatine's Doctrine)|Sith doctrine]] to replace Bane's Rule of Two,<ref name="BoS" /> although he did have the Dark Empire at least run on autopilot in the event that he ended up killed temporarily.<ref name="TEA" /> However, his final death permanently put an end to his plans.
